summary: Iteration 2 e2e testing of the 4 new Netor features (Ders Notlari, CSV bulk import, per-exam scoring, AI Koc) plus regression. Backend: 82 pytest tests (54 regression + 28 new) all pass, including a single real GPT-5.4 AI-coach call that returned a valid Turkish analysis + exactly 7-day plan. Frontend: notes list/modal/video/auto-open from weak topics, score calculator, AI Koc render, and all 5 admin tabs (note+file upload, CSV report, scoring save+persistence) verified on desktop and mobile. One HIGH frontend bug found: Puan Hesapla hangs on an infinite spinner for exams whose scoring_config is null (TYT, AYT), plus several data/seed and navigation gaps.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with body `null` for exams that have no scoring_config (TYT, AYT). Should return a default config or {} so clients can render an empty state; current null directly causes the frontend infinite spinner.

scoring_config is only seeded for exams that already have subjects, so TYT and AYT permanently have no config (skip-if-exists makes it non self-healing). YKS config contains only 1 section (Matematik) although YKS has 5 subjects (Matematik, Turkce, Fizik, Kimya, Tarih), and has multiplier 0.5 / score_type 'Test' - looks like leftover dev data; user-facing calculator therefore only covers Matematik.
All 12 seeded study notes belong to YKS only; every other exam filter on /app/ders-notlari shows the empty state.
Seeded note video_url points to a Rick Astley 'Never Gonna Give You Up' YouTube embed (rickroll placeholder) - irrelevant/unprofessional content in an exam-prep product.
allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests against a wildcard origin; auth also sets httpOnly cookies. Use explicit origin list.
No free-text search parameter, so imported/created questions can only be located via exam/subject/topic filters (test had to work around it).

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting an exam with no scoring_config (TYT, AYT) leaves the page in a permanent loading spinner: `!cfg ? <Spinner/>` never resolves because the API returns null. No section rows, no Hesapla button, no empty state, and no .catch on either api.get call.

No way to add or remove scoring sections. For TYT/AYT (0 sections) the admin only gets base_score/multiplier/score_type fields and can save an empty config, so the broken exams cannot be fixed from the UI.
Mobile nav only exposes Ana Sayfa/Denemeler/Sorular/Eksik/Profil - the three new features (Ders Notlari, Puan Hesapla, AI Koc) are unreachable on mobile except via the WeakTopics deep link.
Note content is raw markdown rendered as plain text ('# Fonksiyonlar', '## Temel Kavramlar', '- ...' visible literally). Needs a markdown renderer or plain-text seed content.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/exams/{id}/scoring returns null -> component stuck loading; needs backend default + frontend fallback/error state.
Filtering by any exam other than YKS always yields the empty state (data gap, not a code bug).

issues: Right-hand hero panel is mostly an empty white/grey gradient; the image only fills the top ~1/3 of the panel
Raw markdown symbols shown to users
Seeded video is an unrelated music video

action_items: FIX HIGH: PuanHesapla - handle null scoring_config (backend: return default {sections:[],base_score:100,multiplier:1,score_type:'Ham Puan'} or 404-with-message; frontend: fallback config + empty state + .catch error state).

Seed/repair scoring_config for ALL exams (TYT, AYT currently null) and rebuild the YKS config from its 5 subjects instead of the leftover single 'Matematik' section with multiplier 0.5 / score_type 'Test'.
Add 'Bolum ekle / kaldir' controls to the Admin Puanlama tab so section lists can be created and edited.
Seed study notes for exams other than YKS and replace the Rick Astley placeholder video_url with real/neutral embeds.
Render note content as markdown (or store plain text).
Add Ders Notlari / Puan Hesapla / AI Koc to the mobile bottom nav (or a 'More' sheet).
Restrict CORS allow_origins to explicit origins since allow_credentials=True and auth sets httpOnly cookies.
critical_code_review_comments: PuanHesapla.jsx L17-24: api.get('/exams') and api.get(`/exams/${id}/scoring`) have no .catch and no error state; any failure leaves a permanent spinner (same pattern in DersNotlari.jsx L51-68).
server.py get_scoring returns e.get('scoring_config') which can be null - endpoint contract should never return a bare null; return a default object.

seed.py seed_extras: `if e.get('scoring_config'): continue` means a partially/incorrectly seeded config never repairs itself; consider versioned seed or rebuild when section names no longer match the exam's subjects.
server.py is 1010 lines - split notes/upload/csv/scoring/ai into routers for maintainability.
import_csv loads every existing question_text into memory (to_list(100000)) to dedupe; use a unique index or per-batch queries for scale.

rca_of_the_issue: Puan Hesapla infinite spinner: seed_extras only writes scoring_config for exams that have at least one subject, so TYT/AYT keep scoring_config=null. GET /api/exams/{id}/scoring returns that null with HTTP 200; PuanHesapla.jsx gates the whole UI on `!cfg ? <Spinner/>` and its api.get has no catch, so the page loads forever. Repro: login demo@sinav.com -> /app/puan-hesapla -> click TYT. Mitigation: return a default scoring config from the backend for unconfigured exams and add a frontend fallback/empty state; also backfill configs for all exams in the seed.
